metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for measuring logical timestamp growth rate as a proxy for synchronization overhead and parallelism exploitation in optimistic concurrency control. It is semantically different from peer candidates: it focuses on timestamp allocation efficiency (growth ratio analysis) rather than workload execution (Contention-Level Workload Evaluation), isolation level comparison (Isolation Level Performance Comparison), or conflict detection logic (Timestamp-Based Conflict Detection). The candidate has clear workflow steps, constraints, and cautions specific to timestamp growth measurement. No existing skill in the registry matches this semantic capability. The single support reference validates the measurement approach.
